entries.title: Replay any delivery from the dashboard
entries.excerpt: Pick a failed delivery, edit the payload if you need to, and send it again.
body: Every delivery now has a Replay button. Replays keep the original signature headers and are marked in the event log so your endpoint can tell them apart.

entries.title: Per-endpoint rate limits
entries.excerpt: Cap deliveries per second for endpoints that can't keep up with bursts.
body: Set a limit on any endpoint and we queue the overflow instead of hammering it. Queued messages keep their order.

entries.title: Faster signature checks in the Node SDK
entries.excerpt: Verifying a signature is now four times faster and allocation-free.
body: The Node SDK uses timing-safe comparison on pre-allocated buffers. Upgrade with npm install @relay/node@latest.

items.a: We retry with exponential backoff for up to three days, then park the message in your dead-letter queue.
